output.explanation: Expanded call-core, the sole input diagram, because peer operations hid nested calls and cross-thread continuations. Preserved its ID and nested setup, bindings, clipboard processing, configuration and teardown under their activations. Pulled out two adjacent diagrams: the PTY/control/parser pipeline and the renderer/snapshot/draw pipeline, connected at specific spawn, mailbox and shared-state sites. No diagrams were left unchanged; there were no existing edges. Verified against the pinned checkout without modifying it. Corrections include setCellSize queuing IO resize directly rather than calling Surface.resize; drawing and animation scheduling occurring after updateFrame; deferred scrollbar publication also running on early returns; search UI not immediately starting a worker; cursor-key scroll/write ordering; OSC 52 write routing; and App.focusSurface running only when focused.

`-- Renderer.drawFrame(sync): shared by renderer worker and Surface.draw() [generic.zig:1716]
    |-- Acquire draw_mutex; drawFrameLocked(sync) [generic.zig:1740]

    |   |   `-- Complete graphics frame/passes (sync=true requests synchronous presentation)
    |   `-- Deferred: end API frame; publish dirty scrollbar [async -> App.tick]
    `-- Release draw_mutex; syncDisplayLink() if requested by no-redraw path
